text:
jenna_csm: Heads-up — Solstice Health renewal hitting procurement gate. They need a formal approver roster (names + emails), a copy of our SOC2 attestation, and confirmation of delegated signer before they’ll route the PO. Can folks confirm who we can surface and where to upload the evidence?

mike_revops: I can assemble the approver ladder. Do we need job titles or just emails?

jenna_csm: Emails + job titles ideally. Procurement is picky about the chain-of-authority.

omar_sales: I have the procurement contact: natalie@solsticeprocure.com. Will call her after 10a PT to get clarity on whether they accept DocuSign or need wet-signed docs.

lisa_legal: For the delegated signer we need the SSO-approved signature matrix. If they accept e-sign, make sure the signer is listed on their vendor onboarding form. I can redline a short attestation clause if needed.

jenna_csm: Thanks. Mike — can you drop the roster in a shared folder? Prefer not to attach PII in channel.

mike_revops: Dropped CSV to the secure share: https://redwood-secure-shared/solstice/approvers.csv — contains names, emails, titles, and signing limits. (let me know if you need different format)

jenna_csm: Got it. Linking the SOC2 cert here: https://redwood-docs/soc2-2025.pdf. Is that sufficient or do they want a letter on company letterhead?

lisa_legal: SOC2 + a short attestation on letterhead should cover it. I can prep the attestation and upload to the same folder by EOD.

omar_sales: Quick Q from procurement: they want invoice header to match legal entity and vendor code. Can someone confirm vendor code for Solstice billing?

mike_revops: Vendor code is RW-ENT-045. Use Legal Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. Also note net30 vs net45 — procurement will request net45 unless we push for net30 because of renewal term.

jenna_csm: We’re targeting net30 — sales is ok to hold firm for this renewal. Omar please flag during the call.

omar_sales: Will do.

jenna_csm: About the signature path — procurement asked for delegated signer name. We can nominate Casey (Finance) as delegated signer up to $150k. @lisa_legal any blockers?

lisa_legal: Casey is in the signature matrix and has delegated authority. No blockers from legal. I’ll include that in the attestation.

jenna_csm: Great. One last thing — procurement wants evidence of last 3 months uptime SLA adherence. Who can pull that quickly?

mike_revops: I can export the per-route SLA report and put a PDF in the folder. Will include the 3-month summary and raw CSV.

esign-bot: Automated: DocuSign envelope created for Solstice Health renewal (envelope ID: 0b9c-7f2a). Assigned signer: Casey (Finance). Status: waiting for recipient.

jenna_csm: Perfect. Omar — after your call, can you confirm the PO route (email + approver) and paste any PO template requirements here? I’ll follow up with procurement and upload the attestation once Lisa posts it. :thumbsup:

omar_sales: Yep will post notes in this thread after the call.

jenna_csm: Thanks all — moving to action items: mike populate folder, lisa attestation by EOD, mike SLA export, omar confirm PO route. I’ll monitor and update renewal tracker. :eyes:
